metadata.purpose: Canonical user-confirmed expert formations used as recommendation priors and comparison baselines.
metadata.policy: All legal expert formations are mandatory candidate-ledger baselines for ordinary combat recommendations. Their expert-recommended status is positive formation-level evidence, not a predetermined winner or an exemption from progression, troop, matchup, mechanics, and lifecycle gates. When endgame Power is not comparable, prefer a complete legal expert portfolio as the conservative default and retain the mechanically ranked portfolio as an alternative. Specialized non-combat or Siege-only requests may mark combat baselines inapplicable with an explicit reason.

formations.name: Velar / Vhagar / Moondancer

recommendation_prior.displacement_rule: May be displaced by known comparable player Power or material objective, matchup, progression, or availability evidence.

formations.strategic_basis: Common all-around high-damage formation with affinity-perfect Shieldbearers, Vhagar's directional Vanguard support, and Velar-to-Moondancer Rising Tide opportunities.
formations.source: User-confirmed common formation supplied on 2026-10-01 and confirmed as an expert-recommended formation on 2026-10-13. Mechanics require fresh validation against canonical dragon records for every recommendation.
